title: Powering the spinning axle
hook: Change torque and predict mechanical power.
misconception: mechanical power stays fixed when torque doubles.
objective: Apply P = τω to compare mechanical power when torque changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With rotation at fixed angular speed with torque along the axis, P = τω. When torque doubles, mechanical power becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model P = τω; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider rotation at fixed angular speed with torque along the axis, with a nonzero initial result. If torque triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on mechanical power?
recall.why: Apply P = τω under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
